_comment: Models for Stoa AI Local. Only Apache-2.0/MIT models, so Stoa can redistribute and rebrand them. 'repos' are tried in order; if none has the file, Stoa searches Hugging Face for 'search'. Files are verified against Hugging Face's SHA-256.

models.name: Small - fast on any PC
models.about: Answers questions, changes settings, finds and summarises files. Basic at building apps.

models.name: Balanced - recommended for 8 GB
models.about: Good at everyday help, files, troubleshooting and small apps.

models.name: Large - best quality (16 GB or a graphics card)
models.about: The strongest local option: better reasoning and app building.
